ruleDefinitions.name: Mshtml.DLL RunHTMLApplication Suspicious Usage
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of commands that leverage the "mshtml.dll" RunHTMLApplication export to run arbitrary code via different protocol handlers (vbscript, javascript, file, http...)

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\\\\.\\\.\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*mshtml.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\#135.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*RunHTMLApplication.*")))
